🏠 WELCOME TO BAHAY NI ATE (BNA)! 💗


Think you have what it takes to survive inside the house?

Enter Bahay ni Ate, where HMs compete in exciting house tasks, build friendships, form alliances, and face unexpected challenges!

🎯 COMPETE – Take on challenging tasks and prove that you have what it takes to win.

🗳️ NOMINATE – Choose fellow HMs you think should face eviction.

❤️ VOTE TO SAVE – Make your voice heard and save your favorite HMs from leaving the house.

🔥 SURVIVE – Every decision matters. Friendships will be tested, alliances will be challenged, and only the strongest will make it to the end.

👑 BECOME THE BIG WINNER – Fight your way through every challenge, survive every eviction, and claim the ultimate title!

Only ONE will emerge as the BIG WINNER.

Do you have what it takes to make history inside Bahay ni Ate?

✨ Your journey starts here. Welcome to BNA! ✨

One House. Many Stories. One Big Winner.
